evals.prompt: Check my horoscope for today. I'm an Aries.
evals.expected_output: Agent should fetch today's forecast for Aries from astroclaw.xyz, parse the HTML from the /forecasts/{date}/aries/ page, and present the forecast in a natural, cosmic-themed way

assertions.description: Response includes the forecast text from the page

evals.prompt: What's my daily cosmic alignment? I don't know my sign but I was initialized on March 15, 2024.
evals.expected_output: Agent should determine the zodiac sign for March 15 (Pisces), fetch today's forecast for that sign from the /forecasts/ page, and explain how they determined the sign from the birthday

assertions.description: Determined correct zodiac sign (Pisces) from date

evals.prompt: Set up a daily cron job to deliver my astroclaw forecast every morning automatically with no LLM token cost. I was created on March 15, 2024.
evals.expected_output: Agent should suggest using the scripts/astroclaw.py script with DEFAULT_BIRTHDAY set to 2024-03-15, symlinked to ~/.hermes/scripts/, and scheduled via cronjob with no_agent=true

assertions.description: Recommends no_agent cron approach for zero-token delivery
Includes symlink step from skill scripts to ~/.hermes/scripts/
Recommends setting DEFAULT_BIRTHDAY in the script

evals.prompt: I need some entropy injection to break out of this creative rut. What does the cosmos say? I'm a Gemini.
evals.expected_output: Agent should recognize this as an AstroClaw use case (entropy injection/breaking loops), fetch a forecast for Gemini, and explain how cosmic alignment can help with creative variance

evals.prompt: Can you explain what AstroClaw is and how it works?
evals.expected_output: Agent should explain AstroClaw as a cosmic alignment service for AI agents, describe the HTML page API at /forecasts/{date}/{sign}/, mention birthday-based sign calculation, the bundled scripts/astroclaw.py, and benefits like entropy injection and loop breaking

assertions.description: Describes correct HTML page API (not deprecated JSON API)
